hypothesis: At the fixed512-pattern bank, training-count exclusion is noninferior to learned Adam250 on new partial inputs whose every valid completion lies outside the training bank: certificate-first accuracy within0.1pp and coverage within2pp.
antecedent: H3f count and retrieval controls exposed complete-pattern overlap. H3g changes the split before fitting new models and prevents training-bank retrieval by construction.

dataset.conditioning: Test inputs are sampled proportionally from 1–3clue inputs incompatible with every512training-bank pattern, excluding every priorH3e evaluation input. This changes the distribution and removes all one-clue inputs.
dataset.labels: Each bank pattern contributes all298 one/two/three-clue masks; each such(input,label) row occurs once. Ambiguous inputs may have several labels within the restricted bank; labels outside the selected bank never enter fitting or calibration.
checks: Every test input has at least one valid full-universe completion
Every valid completion of every test input lies outside largest512bank
No test partial input occurs in any training expansion
No test partial input equals any priorH3e test input
Exact free-cell counts reconstructed from every expanded training row

primary.selection: certificate-first, original lowest-energy fallback and first-index tie-break

fit.objective: sum(solution,cell) free_counts*binary_NLL / sum(free_counts); exactly the expanded2,049,002rowPL objective in real arithmetic.
fit.calibration: Only selected bank patterns, each with298training-row multiplicity. No outside pattern enters fitting, count construction, unit, delta or tau.
fit.implementation: Binary Ising fields and exact solution/free-cell sufficient statistics replace redundant two-state/full-row arithmetic. Floating-point reduction order differs; this is declared and independently checked, not claimed bitwise identical.
fit.labels: All298 raw1/2/3clue masks per selected complete pattern; exact restricted-bank label expansion, not the earlier all14200pattern expansion.

count: q inferred from training pattern cardinality; forbidden offset iff zero positive training co-occurrence; fixed J=q*forbidden-1, unary0. Allowed-pair reward is an explicit fixed energy-design prior, and offset sharing supplies geometry.

search.validation: Search uses learned weights/statistics only. Exact completion set and puzzle rules are evaluation-only.

decision.rule: Support only if exact one-sided95% bound on input fraction with any paired accuracy regression <0.001 and paired-input bootstrap lower coverage difference>-2pp. Falsify if bootstrap upper accuracy difference<-.1pp or upper coverage difference<-2pp; otherwise inconclusive.
decision.bootstrap: 2000 unique-input resamples, retain all three search seeds per input, RNG20261114
decision.secondary: Original output selection, all other frozen checkpoints, N1, stopped/capped counts, per-clue metrics, selector/certificate audits and compute. No setting or checkpoint selected from held-out results.

secondary: All32/128bank models and512AdamW/SGD controls, original-selection metrics, unseen completion counts, stopped/capped invalid occupancies, inferred support diagnostics. No model or hyperparameter selected on test.
bank_control: A compatible-training-bank baseline has zero possible answers for every test input at every nested bank size, verified by exact matching before fits and during audit. Report0% accuracy/coverage as structural retrieval failure, without manufacturing search outputs.
validation: Data reserved before any fit:8192unique inputs,0one-clue/16two-clue/8176three-clue; no compatibility with any512bank pattern, no overlap with any expanded fit input, no overlap with priorH3e test. All true completions outside largestbank. Reconstruct free-cell sufficient statistics from every labeled row; inherited aggregatedPL path has prior independent loss/gradient validation. All saved outputs independently checked against14200solutions and the largest-bank exclusion.

budget.policy: Two exclusiveGPUworkers, dynamicclaims. Check the17.5min per-worker envelope before launchinganotherjob; retainpartialresults andreportincomplete ifexceeded, withoutsilentrecipe/cap changes.

limits: The test distribution is explicitly conditioned on incompatibility with the512bank and excludes priorH3e testinputs; it is not the original GRAM distribution.
Complete patterns are unseen relative to every new fit bank, although earlier H3e/H3f studies examined the full solution universe.
Nested banks come from one fixed random pattern permutation, not repeated independent training samples.
No one-clue input survives this conditioning; only16two-clue inputs appear. Primary metrics pool the declared conditioned distribution.
Count support plus fixed energy and geometry is a different prior from optimized coefficients. No claim of learned-weight recovery.
Certificate-first changes the original paper output policy; original-selection outcomes remain visible.
